youtube.title: Pen Cap Mein Chhota Sa Hole Kyun Hota Hai? 😮 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Kisi sasti pen ka cap dekhiye. Uske upar ek chhota sa hole hota hai. Zyada tar log sochte hain ki yeh ink ko sukhne se bachata hai. Lekin sach yeh hai ki yeh hole aapki jaan bachane ke liye hai.

Bachche pen cap chabate hain, aur kabhi kabhi nigal bhi lete hain. Agar cap saans ki nali mein phans jaye, toh yeh hole se hawa nikalti rehti hai, aur madad aane tak saans chalti rehti hai. Iske liye ISO eleven five forty naam ka safety standard bhi hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
